Israel Approves Use of Crocodiles for Prison Security

Israel's environment minister has reclassified crocodiles, allowing their use for security purposes. This move, reportedly championed by Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, aims to deter prison escapes by potentially deploying the animals around facilities like Ketziot prison, which holds Hamas militants.
